column1: # The rows scripts/sync.sh reads, tab-separated; comments and blank lines are ignored.
#     follow branch:<name>   fast-forward to the upstream branch head
#     follow release:<tag>   fast-forward to the newest point release <tag>.<n> (or <tag> itself); a new release
#                            line (the next <tag>) is a human decision: a new mirror row
#     mica/<name> carries the board's commits on top of that mirror; general carries none
